title: Got an e-challan you think is wrong
triggers: challan for a red light I didn't jump
camera challan but I wasn't there
how to contest a traffic challan

rights.plain_explanation: States enforce traffic rules with speed cameras, CCTV and body-worn cameras, so most challans come with photo or video evidence you can check.
For many traffic offences you can plead guilty and pay the fine without going to court. Once paid, no further case is taken against you for it.

do_now: Look up the challan by vehicle number on the official portal and check the photo or video.
If the vehicle number, place or time is wrong, choose "contest" instead of paying.
Keep proof: where you and your vehicle actually were, fuel bills, location history.
Never pay through an agent or a link sent on WhatsApp.
user_at_fault_cases: If the photo clearly shows your vehicle breaking the rule, the challan is valid. Paying it online closes the matter.

escalation.label: Virtual Courts portal
escalation.detail: Search your challan, then pick "I wish to contest the case". You get the court and date in the acknowledgement.

escalation.label: Free legal aid
escalation.detail: Call NALSA on 15100 or visit your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) at the district court. Women, children, people in custody and people below the income limit get a free lawyer.

notes: Some states route disputes through their own traffic police grievance pages as well.
